purpose: This silver table cleans the bronze nyc_flights capture of 2013 NYC-area flight departures, casting decimal-encoded numeric fields to integers, typing time_hour as a timestamp, and removing Airbyte capture metadata, to feed downstream flight-delay and on-time-performance analysis.
usage: Consumers should treat dep_time, dep_delay, arr_time, arr_delay, and air_time as nullable (roughly 3% null each) and decide whether to filter those rows before computing delay statistics; dep_time, sched_dep_time, arr_time, and sched_arr_time remain in HHMM integer format rather than true time-of-day and should be combined with time_hour or year/month/day/hour/minute for timestamp reconstruction.
limitations: Cleanup did not resolve tailnum nulls (null_rate 0.009154, 1521 rows) or the roughly 3% nulls in dep_time, dep_delay, arr_time, arr_delay, and air_time; the declared grain (year, month, day, carrier, flight, origin) was not verified against the warehouse for true row uniqueness and should be checked before approval, and the HHMM-encoded time integer columns were not converted to true time types since the profile gives no evidence to safely reconstruct timestamps from them.
